title: odd-dialog
description: A modal dialog: a native `<dialog>` shown modally, so the rest of the page is inert until it closes. Escape closes it unless `closedby="none"`; with `closedby="any"`, so does a press on the backdrop. A `<form method="dialog">` inside closes it with the value of the button that submitted it.
$comment: Slots: default, "footer", "header". A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

label.description: The title, which names the dialog. Required.

alert.description: Makes it an alert dialog: an urgent message that needs a response, such as confirming that something is deleted. Its body describes it.

closedby.description: What closes it besides its controls: Escape (`closerequest`), also a press on the backdrop (`any`), or neither (`none`). The browser does it where it can; elsewhere the dialog does.

no-close.description: Hides the close button. Keep another way out, such as a Cancel button.

returnValue.description: The `close()` argument, or the value of the button that submitted its form.
